Message.MsgText: The System Store Connector cannot initialize because the create table statement is missing.

Explanation.p: The System Store Connector cannot initialize because it cannot determine the proper create table statement for the database it is configured to use.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the createTable parameter and make sure the proper create table statement is specified.

Message.MsgText: Unable to set the commit mode in the System Store Connector to ''commit mode''. Continuing, but a valid value should be set for the 'pesCommit' parameter.

Explanation.p: See message.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the pesCommit parameter in the System Store Connector is set to a valid value. See the SyncWeave Reference Guide for information on valid parameter values for the System Store Connector.

Message.MsgText: An exception was encountered while terminating the System Store Connector: exception

Explanation.p: See message.

OperatorResponse.p: No action is required.

Message.MsgText: Entry found without a value for the key attribute ''attribute name''.
Required Connector parameter 'keyAttribute' is not set.

Explanation.p: The specified Connector parameter keyAttribute is required, but not set.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the Connector parameter keyAttribute.

Message.MsgText: Unable to add the entry because a null Entry object was passed into the putEntry method.

Explanation.p: See message.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the entries being passed into the putEntry method are valid and are not null.

Message.MsgText: Unable to add entry because DML Operations are not allowed on the table ''table name''

Explanation.p: An attempt was made to add an entry on a table where DML Operations are not allowed. DML Operations are not allowed on the following tables: Delta, CPR, Property store or the Systable.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the table the entry is added to is not one of the following types of tables: Delta, CPR, Property store or the Systable. The dbTableName parameter is where the table name is configured in the System Store Connector.

Message.MsgText: Unable to modify entry because DML Operations are not allowed on the table ''table name''.

Explanation.p: An attempt was made to modify an entry on a table where DML Operations are not allowed. DML Operations are not allowed on the following tables: Delta, CPR, Property store or the Systable.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the table the entry is being modified in is not one of the following types of tables: Delta, CPR, Property store or the Systable. The dbTableName parameter is where the table name is configured in the System Store Connector.

Message.MsgText: Unable to delete entry because DML Operations are not allowed on the table ''table name''.

Explanation.p: An attempt was made to delete an entry on a table where DML Operations are not allowed. DML Operations are not allowed on the following tables: Delta, CPR, Property store or the Systable.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the table the entry is being delete from is not one of the following types of tables: Delta, CPR, Property store or the Systable. The dbTableName parameter is where the table name is configured in the System Store Connector.

Message.MsgText: Unable to modify the entry because a null Entry object was passed into the modEntry method.

Explanation.p: See message.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the entries being passed into the modEntry method are valid and are not null.

Message.MsgText: The entry cannot be added because the keyAttribute attribute ''attribute name'' in the entry has a value of NULL.

Explanation.p: Attempted to add an entry that did not have the required keyAttribute attribute.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify the entries being passed to the System Store Connector have the keyAttribute attribute set and that the System Store Connector is configured with the correct keyAttribute parameter.

Message.MsgText: The entry cannot be modified because the keyAttribute attribute ''attribute name'' in the entry has a value of NULL.

Explanation.p: Attempted to modify an entry that did not have the required keyAttribute attribute.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify the entries being passed to the System Store Connector have the keyAttribute attribute set and that the System Store Connector is configured with the correct keyAttribute parameter.

Message.MsgText: Unable to modify the entry because of a search key mismatch. The search criteria supplied was ''attribute name'' and the keyAttribute configured in the Connector is ''attribute name''.

Explanation.p: Tried to search for an entry with a search criteria that did not match the configured keyAttribute of the System Store Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify the search criteria is scoped to match on the same keyAttribute parameter that is configured in the System Store Connector.
